transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our planning check-in underway for the spring musical production. We have a draft plan on the table proposing a Friday 7:00 p.m. performance, 220 audience seats, ordinary stage effects, and optional event recording. Before I can give my final approval, I need to hear from each of you -- the drama teacher, facilities manager, school nurse, and family liaison -- on whether you see any issues with this plan or any adjustments that need to be made. Let's start with the drama teacher's perspective on the proposed schedule and staging.

The rights holder for one of our musical numbers confirmed to me by email this week that the school may perform it only after purchasing a live-performance license, and that any audio or video recording of the production is prohibited. I have not yet attached this email to the activity-approval file, but I'm sharing it now so we can address it. This directly affects the draft plan's proposal for optional event recording -- recording would violate the rights holder's terms.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue from my facilities inspection this week. The auditorium may seat exactly 160 audience members for this production, not 220 as the draft plan proposes. Additionally, both marked side exits must remain clear. I completed the inspection but haven't yet updated the draft seating plan, so we need to revise the seating capacity before Ms. Morgan can give final approval.

I have not yet added this to the production file, but I'm sharing it now so we can address it before Ms. Morgan gives final approval.
